title: Strong match
description: A backend internship that fits the profile: evidence for every requirement.
posting_text:
Backend Developer Intern - Nimbus Labs (Barcelona, hybrid)
About the role: You will help our platform team build internal APIs.
Requirements:
- Python
- Experience building REST APIs with FastAPI or Flask
- SQL
- Git
Nice to have:
- Docker
- CI pipelines (GitHub Actions)
What you'll do: write and test API endpoints, review pull requests, document services.

paragraphs.text: Nimbus Labs' focus on building robust backend services makes the Backend Developer Intern role an ideal fit for my background as a computer engineering student focused on backend applications in Barcelona.

I have hands-on experience developing backend solutions in Python and FastAPI. For my Home Network Monitor project, I built a FastAPI backend that scans the local network and serves device status to an HTML dashboard, configured to run as an automatic background service. In another Python project, I automated flight price tracking using scheduled workflows in GitHub Actions and managed version control with Git.

During my internship at Example Consulting, I collaborated within an Agile team to design and execute functional test cases for a banking web application. I also tracked defects in Jira and routinely used SQL queries to perform data validation across backend datasets.
